author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

This year, a new variety of corn has appeared in the mountains. Its entire cob shines with a translucent ruby-purple hue, with plump, glossy kernels and even the delicate corn silk tinged with a soft purple color. Locals call it Ruby Purple Corn.
Unlike the glutinous corn and sweet corn we usually eat, this is a fresh mountain-grown corn variety that is naturally suitable for eating raw. With its exceptionally low starch content, it does not have the heavy, floury texture or raw, grainy taste of ordinary corn. Instead, it offers a lighter, fruit-like sweetness and a crisp, refreshing flavor.
It can be enjoyed fresh to appreciate its natural sweetness, or cooked in a variety of dishes that bring warmth and tradition to the table. Freshly picked from the fields of Yunnan, this purple gem brings the sweetness of the mountains into everyday meals and simple moments of home cooking.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge,
title: Ruby Purple Corn — low-starch purple treasure. Light, juicy fresh; sweet-savory when cooked.【滇西小哥】
